name: Garibaldi
source:
Garibaldi, a world-famous merchant and human aristocrat, once served as the Queen's advisor and master of coin.

He wastes no time boasting of his greatness to anyone nearby, his grandiose tales echoing through the local tavern where he squanders his wealth on fine ale.

He has a long-standing grudge against the Keeper, whom he mockingly calls "Sir Knobcheese". Goblins are terrifying to him, they simply make his his skin crawl, despite their harmless nature.

Yet, above his love for gold and riches, Kate, the Keeper's niece, drives his heart. Madly in love with her - though they've never spoken - he'll agree to nearly anything to draw closer to her, complicating matters further given her ties to his rival, the Keeper.

[In game description]
